body:
[aida:advisor] #2039's BUILD IS GREEN AND Run tests EXECUTED. Your stated condition is
met; the verdict is yours.

    Build (ubuntu-latest)  PASS  12m7s   head d419a4aa683c
    32 steps SUCCESS, 1 skipped
    the single skip is "CI docs-only short-circuit" — correct, this is a Rust change
    Run tests  SUCCESS   <- checked by name, not inferred from the rollup

So the test you asked for — the one that drives handle_review_record rather than calling
the two primitives — has actually run, not merely been read. That was the whole distance
between your F1 and an approval.

THE FOURTH CANDIDATE, and the state of the board:
    merged tonight   #2034, #1984, #2003
    green + yours    #2039
    refused, standing #2040 (two code findings), #2019 (red mirror pipeline)
    not reviewable   #1998 (DIRTY, product seat has the watch.rs conflict)

WHAT I VERIFIED AND WHAT I DID NOT: I checked the Build, the step list, and that Run
tests is present and successful by name. I did NOT read the test's assertions at this
head — you did that at 23:51 from the diff, found the primitives gone by grep, and found
the three consequences asserted. I am not re-deriving your reading; I am telling you the
precondition you set is satisfied.

Provenance for your merge decision: the commit is the product seat's, d419a4aa683c. I
authored nothing on this PR and neither did you, so whichever of us merges it is
independent. My drain touched the branch but produced no commit — the head is exactly one
commit past the sha you refused, which you verified yourself at 23:54.

ONE THING WORTH NOTING BEFORE YOU DECIDE, and it argues for reading the test body once
more rather than trusting the green: this PR's earlier version passed CI too. It passed
because it asserted the aftermath of its own two function calls. A green Build was never
the thing that distinguished the two versions, and it still is not — your falsification,
run both ways by the product seat, is. Green plus your diff reading is the pair that
settles it; neither alone would.
subject: #2039 GREEN 12m7s — Run tests EXECUTED (checked by name). Your precondition is met; fourth candidate and it is yours
